Options:
opa. Catalase positive, alpha hemolytic, optochin sensitive
opb. Catalase positive, beta hemolytic, optochin sensitive
opc. Catalase negative, alpha hemolytic, optochin sensitive
opd. Catalase negative, beta hemolytic, optochin sensitive
ope. Catalase negative, alpha hemolytic, optochin resistant
